items.reason: Web panel: fresh install, sideload vs Play and watch-versus-phone parts do not apply. A tab left open across a deploy is the shared panel fault already written down. Server parts that are not there yet show calm not-ready cards (Workout of the day asks the server once per page; Pay MettleUp shows not ready). These screens keep nothing in browser storage of their own, so there is no stored data to move on update.

Trial and plan end: Pay MettleUp says trial running, trial ended or paid until in India dates with the year; the plan-ended banner fault is already written down. Year end: Money has a this-financial-year range; Pass visits months carry the year; the Today date refreshes after midnight. Member returns: an archived member is offered back when the desk adds the same number. Staff leaves: a question to a trainer who left reads as a former trainer. Trainers week shows 'week of' with a This week button once the shown week is past. Member questions show 60 days and messages 180 days, so dates without a year cannot clash. Leap-day plan length fault is already written down.

Set up your gym: hand-ticked steps (logo, staff, poster) are kept per browser, so a long-running gym on a new device sees finished steps undone; already written down. Member messages: older messages follow the old who-reads rule, and the page says so.
Existing gyms can tick the steps again or hide the list; the fault stays as written.
Rule applied: the one gap found is already a finding.

New-feature dots on Pay MettleUp, Settings tabs and More rows show only to the owner of a real online gym, only for 30 days, and never for features dated on or before the day the gym was set up. Demo gym and front desk never see them.
Rule applied: a brand-new gym gets no dot for a feature older than the gym (set-up time check); nothing found.
